description: Ministry of Industry and Commerce - Notifying that the purpose for which the Jay Jay Foundation was authorised as a purpose to which the powers and facilities of the Societies Ordinance ought to be extended
reasoning: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal statute) to authorize a society's purpose and grant a legal exemption from a specific section of that Ordinance. The content is primarily about applying and modifying legal/regulatory provisions, not about government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
